name: Sky (Conduit Force of Nature)
body:
A connection to the sky is a connection to the air, winds and weather around you. They are suffused with the unbound power of the wind.

Manifestation: A connection to the sky will manifest as a constant rustling of their hair or clothing as if a light breeze, a clean scent of air or petrichor, lighter colored hair, skin or eyes.

Communing: Communing with the sky could be taking long breaths of fresh air, watching sand or dust blow in a breeze, or watching clouds move.

Connection Spells: (1st-level/0th) – breeze (2nd-level/1st) – windy escape (4th-level/2nd) – gust of wind (6th-level/3rd) – fly (8th-level/4th) – tailwind (10th-level/5th) – overland flight (12th-level/6th) – path of the winds (14th-level/7th) – control weather (16th-level/8th) – wandering weather (18th-level/9th) – winds of vengeance

Added Spells to Learn: Spells with the air and/or electricity descriptors.

Primal Empathy: The conduit may communicate with flying animals, magical beasts, fey and other creatures that fly at the GM’s discretion.

Natural Skill: Fly

Natural Movement: The conduit does not have their speed reduced by high wind nor is pushed back by any wind effect.

Charged Air (Su)

Beginning with 1st level, so long as the conduit has at least 1 primal point remaining, they deal 1 electricity damage with any melee attacks they make and 1 additional electricity damage per spell level of any spell that deals electricity damage they cast.

Additionally, the conduit may expend a primal point to create a forceful cutting wind. So long as the target is exposed to air, they must make a Reflex save or take 1d4 slashing damage per 2 class levels the conduit possesses. A successful save halves the damage. If the conduit has 1 primal point remaining after expending a point in this way, the ability deals 1 additional electricity damage per d4 of dice damage dealt. This damage is not reduces on a successful saving throw.

Skyborne (Su)

At 5th level, so long as the conduit has 1 primal point remaining, they increase their base speed by 10 feet. Additionally, they increase their fly speed by the same amount and their maneuverability increases by 1 step, to a maximum of perfect.

A Leaf on the Wind (Su)

At 9th level, the conduit can expend a primal point as an immediate action to grant themselves the effects of the improved evasion against a triggering effect. Additionally, they can expend a primal point as a swift action to gain a bonus on Acrobatics checks equal to their class level for 1 round.

Swirling Winds (Su)

At 13th level, so long as the conduit has 1 primal point remaining, they are under a constant feather fall effect.

Additionally, they may expend a primal point as a swift action to cause winds to pick up around them causing any ranged attack made against them or a target within 5 feet to have a 50% miss chance.

Master of the Winds (Ex)

At 17th level, the conduit no longer needs to have primal points remaining for the ongoing effects of the charged air, swirling winds, or skyborne abilities and all allies within 30 feet gain the benefits of a leaf on the wind when the ability is used.

Polymorph: The Conduit, © 2024, Orphaned Bookworm Productions, LLC, Author: Connor Bates.
